sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body:
A dimmer that replaces an ordinary switch and puts the lights on a schedule, a remote and your phone.

No rewiring, no hub in the wall: it installs in the same box as the switch it replaces.
The first smart switch I didn't have to explain to anyone.
